rag_live_retrieval.relevance_label: target_quote: a chunk of the TARGET paper holding the gold quote (or half of one split by a chunk boundary). Strict: the same chemistry stated by another corpus paper counts as NOT relevant.
rag_live_retrieval.relevance_label_any_paper: participants_named: a chunk of ANY corpus paper naming every defining participant on token boundaries. Looser; reported beside, never instead.
rag_live_retrieval.score_note: build_hybrid_scorer min-max normalises both halves WITHIN each query's pool, so the top hit scores ~1.0 whatever its relevance; the returned score cannot support a rejection floor, and the production retriever applies none.
rag_live_retrieval.corpus_source: latest committed 01_source_text.txt per gold paper (git ls-files)
